law_name: Act of 10 May 2018 on the Protection of Personal Data
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: Not covered: Poland added no rules for deceased persons, so GDPR (living persons only) applies by default
research_exemption: Not in the 2018 Act: Higher Education and Science Act art. 469b(2) allows special-category data for research if results are non-identifying; anonymise once purpose reached
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; no specific rule found in the 2018 Act (unconfirmed)
